blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Facing assistant coach and Armed Forces of the Philippines setter Jessie Lopez, National University-Archipelago Builders beat the winless Cavaliers with a 25-14, 25-16, 25-19 victory to bounce back in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Saturday at Philsports Arena. NU recovered from a tough first loss to the defending champion Criss Cross, with setter Greg Ancheta leading the way against Lopez, who has been his mentor since his UAAP days, when their program won six consecutive titles. Ancheta, an Alas Pilipinas pool member, dished out 19 excellent sets, as the trio of Jade Disquitado, Leo Ordiales and […]...
